page.layout: One page of text, single column; a title block of centred heading lines and an italic dedicatory letter at full width; no margin notes. Page number at head left; signature line at right below the letter's signature. Digitiser's watermark at lower right is excluded.

main_text.l: eruditis & piis Theologis communicare. Fidem mihi faciet
vel unicus Scultetus, & iste communis noster amicus, ὁ
νῦν ἐν ἁγίοις, cujus Epistolam hic repræsentabo.

l.i: Vir Clarissime, Legi, & ut, quod res est, dicam,
cum voluptate legi, tuas de Tetragrammato medi-
tationes, rogoque ut per pralum illa communices
Theologiæ studiosis. Joh. Seldenus de Diis Syrorum
procul dubio tibi visus est. Is quoque hanc materiam
attigit, sed paucis. §. 48. omisisti annum, quo Ga-
latinus floruit. Bucholzerus meus in Indice Chronolog.
Epistolam ad Reuchlinum. Hunc ergo annum tibi nominandum existimem. Vale. Embdæ 1623. 18. May.

main_text.l: Ex eo in vestra urbe prodiit doctissimi viri tractatus de genuina antiquitate vocalium, cum appendice ora-
tione de hoc ipso nomine. Tum vere plane sede-
bat, meum istum fœtum æternis tenebris sepelire.
Tam enim eleganter, tam plene Orationis istius au-
thor de isthoc argumento disserebat, nihil ut à me
addi posse existimarem. At rursus, postquam incidi
in postremos libros Miscellaneorum Cl. Viri, D. N i c.
FULLERI, ut vidi magnum virum in appendice
disputare adversus Cl. Drusii præceptoris mei, alio-
rumque eruditissimorum virorum sententiam, ut co-
gnovi quosdam vitio creatos Prætores, iis qui Adonai
legunt, superstitionis & nequiter imminuta textus efficacia crimen impingere, consilia in contrarium re-culi.

page.notes: Catchword "culi." is the last word of the final line, shown at the right; it is also the end of the printed line and is reproduced there. Greek lines in the dedication and signature are transcribed as best read. Some letters in the running text are faint (e.g. "Scultetus", "tuas"). Printed "ꝗ" forms do not occur on this page.
